meta.niche: Client-experience and booking software for salons, spas, medspas, and barbershops

analysis.summary: Zenoti goes after rivals with comparison pages, while Mangomint and Phorest publish in volume. Boulevard added two case studies. Mindbody, Vagaro and Fresha showed no new activity.

points.text: Zenoti published or refreshed six 2026 comparison pages, including one against Boulevard, aimed at buyers weighing a switch.
Mangomint added 26 new pages, 22 of them for learners: guides, idea lists and free templates. It has no refreshed pages.
Phorest added 32 pages and updated 43, pushing med spa, multi-location and payment-cost topics. Many titles repeat across pages.

Boulevard.play: Two new case studies with hard results: 53% more appointments, 40% sales growth.

Zenoti.play: Names rivals in 2026 comparison pages on payroll, AI receptionist and charting.

Mindbody.play: No new or updated pages. Site is mostly templated /business/ and /company/ pages.

Vagaro.play: No new or updated pages. Site is a 193-page /pro/ template section.

Mangomint.play: Publishes guides, idea lists, research and free templates for many beauty niches.
Mangomint.aimed: Owners researching how to run salons

Phorest.play: Pushes med spa, multi-location, marketplace-cost and payment-cost pages, with many repeated titles.

Fresha.play: Only 3 pages on the site and no activity.

shared.title: Med spa focus
shared.text: Zenoti compares medspa charting, Phorest launched med spa and clinic pages, Mangomint wrote med spa forms and menus. Boulevard has one med spa page, the SkinRN case study.

shared.title: Rival cost framing
shared.text: Zenoti names competitors feature by feature. Phorest argues marketplaces and payments cost more than they look. Both speak to buyers comparing options, a group Boulevard wants to win.

gaps.title: Switching guide
gaps.text: No company publishes how to move from another provider: data transfer, staff training, launch timeline. Boulevard's target buyers are switching, so this fits them directly.

gaps.title: Boulevard vs Zenoti reply
gaps.text: Only Zenoti covers this matchup, and on its own terms. Boulevard can publish its own comparison on payroll, memberships and charting.

gaps.title: Multi-location playbooks
gaps.text: Only Phorest has real multi-location pages. Mangomint's content suits single sites. Boulevard could own guides for running many locations, backed by its multi-location nail studio case.

versus.Zenoti: Zenoti publishes comparison pages, one against Boulevard. Boulevard's recent output is two case studies and no comparison pages.
versus.Mindbody: Mindbody has no new content and relies on templated pages. Boulevard is publishing, though only two pages.
versus.Vagaro: Vagaro published nothing new. Boulevard's two fresh case studies are more active, but still small.
versus.Mangomint: Mangomint publishes 26 learning pages. Boulevard's two pages are case studies aimed at buyers, with no how-to content.
versus.Phorest: Phorest publishes and refreshes at a much larger scale and covers multi-location. Boulevard shows no updates and just one multi-location story.
versus.Fresha: Fresha has almost no content on the site. Boulevard has a far bigger library.
